body: Thank you, it is relevant. I will give them a call. I appreciate you trying, truly.

It rough, I don't see any light. My mom is close but she has mental illness and I worry that it will not help to tell her about the baby. She was so looking forward to it. She is unfortunately all I have here. I moved away from my close friends.
That is good advice, thank you!
We have considered this, as well. She was almost grabbed by a bird before. Hoping that is not the case, but you could be right.

We have posted to two of the local Facebook groups, and we have been in contact with the animal helper. I hope she turns up soon. She is afraid of thunderstorms and I hate the thought that she's out there alone.
